seo.description: Listening comprehension test for intermediate students (CEFR B1). Watch a video about world places and choose the correct answers.

parts:
B1 English Listening Test

Watch a video about a church built on the top of a cliff, and for questions 1 to 7, decide if the sentences are true or false.

For more videos like this, go to Great Big Story
Questions

questions.prompt: Abuna Yemata Guh is the only church built in the rocks in the Tigray Region in Ethiopia.
From the bottom of the cliff, there is only one path that leads to the church.
It was built more than 500 years ago.
People say Father Yemata chose this location for the chruch to test the faith of the churchgoers.
The church was discovered 47 years ago by the priest.
Visitors must take off their shoes at the top of the cliff, before entering the church.
The most dangerous point of the climb is just before the entrance to the church.
